_about: Shared kit parts on the ILCA 7 (Tools/boatkit/bk_parts.py), placed by build_fleet.py's place_kit. Body frame metres (+y starboard); on: deck, sole (the cockpit well's floor) or z; dz: raised; mirror: also at -y; yaw degrees about Z; flip: turned over (the kit's blocks hang from their head). Replaces the hand-built ratchet block on its post in the well and the control lines' cam cleats either side of the well's forward end (Boats 11).
